CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Medical Center
Department of Clinical Genetics

Patient: [redacted name]
MRN: [redacted ID]
DOB: [redacted date]
Specimen ID: [redacted ID]
Physician: Dr. [redacted name]

SPECIMEN TYPE: Peripheral blood
DATE COLLECTED: [redacted date]
DATE RECEIVED: [redacted date]
DATE REPORTED: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Rule out Down syndrome. Evaluate for Facioscapulohumeral Muscular Dystrophy.

TEST PERFORMED
G-banded chromosome analysis at 400-450 band resolution

PRIOR TESTING
Rapid aneuploidy PCR screening completed [redacted date] - negative for common trisomies

RESULT
Karyotype: 46,XX

No evidence of trisomy 21 or other numerical abnormalities detected.
No major structural chromosomal rearrangements identified.

TECHNICAL INFORMATION
20 metaphases analyzed from phytohemagglutinin-stimulated peripheral blood lymphocyte cultures. Sample quality was sufficient to exclude numerical abnormalities and major structural rearrangements. Resolution adequate for detection of abnormalities >5-10 Mb.

INTERPRETATION
Normal female karyotype. No evidence of Down syndrome (trisomy 21) or other major chromosomal abnormalities detected within the resolution limits of this analysis.

This result does not exclude submicroscopic deletions, duplications, or single gene disorders including Facioscapulohumeral Muscular Dystrophy (FSHD).

RECOMMENDATIONS
Molecular genetic testing for Facioscapulohumeral Muscular Dystrophy is in process under separate requisition and will be reported independently.

This test was developed and its performance characteristics determined by [redacted location] Medical Center Clinical Cytogenetics Laboratory.

Electronically signed by:
[redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Director, Clinical Cytogenetics Laboratory
[redacted date]
